capabilities_actually_used.access_path: Official Google AI, Firebase, Apps Script, Colab, and Gemini terms URLs

executive_delta: Repaired the Google evidence pack, separated verified quota facts from account-specific or unsupported privacy claims, and added the missing billing, region, terms, side-effect, and preview-model gates.

facts.claim: Google's Gemini API terms distinguish Unpaid and Paid Services and state that EEA, Switzerland, and UK users receive the Paid Services data-use treatment for all Services even when offered free.
Google's Colab FAQ says free resources are not guaranteed or unlimited, usage limits fluctuate, and idle timeouts, maximum VM lifetime, and available hardware vary over time.

Cloud Firestore documents one free database per project and free quotas of 1 GiB stored data, 50,000 reads/day, 20,000 writes/day, 20,000 deletes/day, and 10 GiB/month outbound transfer; quotas reset around midnight Pacific time.
Apps Script quotas are account-type dependent, per user, reset 24 hours after the first request, and are subject to change without notice.
The Google evidence pack does not itself authorize UJ-INF-001, UJ-MEM-001, UJ-KNW-001, UJ-MED-001, or UJ-ADK-001.

assumptions.statement: Apps Script triggers, webhooks, OAuth grants, and document writes are side effects even when the service itself has no usage fee.
